intro.title: Walk with Jesus
intro.body: Follow Jesus along the road and listen to His teaching about the Good Samaritan. At each stop, answer a question about what happened in Scripture. A wrong answer costs 15 Journey Strength; bread and water restore it as you travel.

stops.title: The road in Jesus' story
stops.body: Jesus begins the parable with a traveler who is attacked by robbers and left badly wounded.

choices.label: From Jerusalem to Jericho
choices.response: Jesus says the traveler was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho.

choices.label: From Bethlehem to Nazareth
choices.response: The traveler was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho.

stops.title: Compassion on the road
stops.body: A priest and a Levite see the wounded man, but both pass by on the other side.
stops.prompt: Who stops and is moved with compassion?

choices.label: The priest
choices.response: The priest passes by. It is the Samaritan traveler who stops and shows compassion.

choices.label: A Samaritan traveler
choices.response: The Samaritan traveler sees the wounded man, draws near, and is moved with compassion.

stops.title: The Samaritan gives care
stops.body: The Samaritan approaches the wounded man and begins caring for his injuries.
stops.prompt: What does the Samaritan pour over the man's wounds?

choices.label: Oil and wine
choices.response: The Samaritan pours oil and wine over the wounds and bandages them.

choices.label: Water and milk
choices.response: The Samaritan uses oil and wine, then bandages the man's wounds.

stops.title: Mercy continues
stops.body: The Samaritan lifts the wounded man onto his own animal and carries him somewhere safe.
stops.prompt: Where does the Samaritan take the wounded man?

choices.label: Back to Jerusalem
choices.response: The Samaritan takes the wounded man to an inn and continues caring for him.

choices.label: To an inn
choices.response: The Samaritan takes him to an inn, cares for him, and provides for his continued care.

stops.title: Go and live mercifully
stops.body: Jesus' teaching makes neighbor-love concrete: notice suffering, draw near, and let compassion become action. Carry that invitation into the choices you make beyond this road.
